en: A monochrome postcard showing a full‑length studio photograph of a woman dressed in ancient Greek-style drapery and sandals, posed in profile with one arm raised to her forehead as if gazing into the distance and the other arm extended in front of her. The card has a light border and printed captions in French and Greek at the bottom, along with a faint seal on the lower left and a website credit at the very bottom.
